LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Fusilier.title: line fusilier
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Fusilier.description: [PAWN_nameDef] took the shilling at nineteen and spent years in a red coat, loading and firing in the front rank while the cannon roared overhead.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Engineer.title: steam engineer
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Engineer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] built boilers, beam engines and iron bridges, and once redesigned a pump on the back of a menu during dinner.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Miner.title: coal miner
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Miner.description: [PAWN_nameDef] went down the pit at dawn and came up after dark for twelve years. [PAWN_pronoun] can tell good rock from bad by the sound it makes.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Surgeon.title: regimental surgeon
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Surgeon.description: [PAWN_nameDef] followed the regiment with a saw, a bottle of spirits and a firm belief in boiling everything. [PAWN_possessive] patients usually lived.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Clerk.title: company clerk
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Clerk.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the ledgers of a great trading company, sixty hours a week at a high desk. [PAWN_pronoun] can find a missing penny in a thousand pages.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Gamekeeper.title: gamekeeper
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Gamekeeper.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept the deer and pheasants of a great estate and the poachers away from them, with a rifle and a pair of patient dogs.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Officer.title: cavalry officer
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Officer.description: [PAWN_nameDef] bought a commission in the dragoons and led a charge that became a famous painting. Few in the painting survived.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Publican.title: publican
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Publican.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a village pub, brewed the ale, settled the fights and heard every secret in the parish.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_MillChild.title: mill child
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_MillChild.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked between the clattering looms of a cotton mill from the age of eight, small enough to crawl under the machines.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Schoolboy.title: boarding school pupil
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Schoolboy.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was sent to a cold boarding school where [PAWN_pronoun] learned Latin, cricket and how to keep a straight face.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Farmhand.title: farmhand
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Farmhand.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up mucking out stables and bringing in the harvest on a rainy hill farm.
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Mudlark.title: river mudlark
LanguageData.HE_Albion_BS_Mudlark.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up searching the river mud at low tide for coal, nails and lost coins to sell.
